title: Local charging queue fairness sheet
summary: A fair-use sheet for a shared charging point so phones for alerts, medical devices, translation, lighting, and family contact are prioritized without conflict.
content: Core sequence: 1) Separate life-safety charging from comfort charging before the queue starts. 2) Write device owner, purpose, start percentage, target percentage, and removal time. 3) Cap routine phone charging at a useful minimum when others are waiting for medical or alert devices. 4) Remove damaged hot swollen or wet batteries from the queue and do not charge them.
